description.p: Tests and calibrates Xbox, DualShock 4, DualSense, Switch Pro and generic controllers: buttons, sticks, triggers, rumble, gyroscope, touchpad, latency, circularity, deadzones and response curves. Everything runs locally, with no telemetry.

Testa e calibra controles Xbox, DualShock 4, DualSense, Switch Pro e genéricos: botões, analógicos, gatilhos, vibração, giroscópio, touchpad, latência, circularidade, deadzone e curvas. Tudo roda no seu computador, sem telemetria.

Prueba y calibra controles Xbox, DualShock 4, DualSense, Switch Pro y genéricos: botones, sticks, gatillos, vibración, giroscopio, touchpad, latencia, circularidad, zonas muertas y curvas. Todo funciona en tu equipo, sin telemetría.
New app icon in dark and light, with a setting to pick it.
New controller drawings (DualSense, Xbox Series, Switch Pro and generic) that follow the app theme.
Button health check: chatter, missed presses, sticking buttons and release bounce, with what to do.
Spanish translation; Windows .exe, RPM, Flatpak and Arch packages.
